description: Grass and ground cover give way under the subject: blades beneath it are pressed down under its underside (grass under a car floor still stands up to the floor), blades close to it lean away, and the footprint travels with a moving subject, so nothing pokes through. Added to grounded subjects in worlds with foliage, never on a rigged subject or one playing its own clip (the underside is measured once, at frame 1; a rig or clip would move it).
